text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock C at gains felt rewarding, but I should not sell only to lock in a profit; decide based on my plan and each stock’s prospects.","My average cost can make losses feel especially painful and mistakes hard to admit; I should assess holdings from today’s outlook rather than anchor on purchase price.","Small account swings do not require action. Since I trade infrequently, I should be patient and make deliberate buy, sell, or hold decisions instead of reacting to short-term moves."]}
